tasks.q: Ти — майбутній першокурсник Гоґвортсу і поки що живеш по сусідству з Дурслями. Щоранку ти бачиш худого хлопця в завеликому одязі. Його звати Гаррі, і він спить у комірчині під сходами. Сьогодні в Дадлі день народження — і ти все бачиш через паркан.

His name is Harry, and he sleeps in a cupboard under the stairs. Today is Dudley's birthday, and you see everything through the fence.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Present Simple = habits, routines, facts (Harry makes breakfast every morning). Present Continuous = actions in progress now or around now (Look! Dudley is counting his presents). B1: always + continuous = annoying habit (He's always complaining). State verbs (know, want, like, belong) are not normally used in the continuous.
tasks.q_pl: Present Simple = habits, routines, facts (Harry makes breakfast every morning). Present Continuous = actions in progress now or around now (Look! Dudley is counting his presents). B1: always + continuous = annoying habit (He's always complaining). State verbs (know, want, like, belong) are not normally used in the continuous.
tasks.q_en: Present Simple = habits, routines, facts (Harry makes breakfast every morning). Present Continuous = actions in progress now or around now (Look! Dudley is counting his presents).
